b6_reason: Shortest wavelength (series limit, n->infinity) gives 1/lambda = R/n1^2; Balmer n1=2 gives R/4, Brackett n1=4 gives R/16, so lambda_Brackett = 4 x lambda_Balmer.
b6_working: 1/lambda_Balmer = R(1/2^2 - 0) = R/4 -> lambda = 4/R; 1/lambda_Brackett = R(1/4^2 - 0) = R/16 -> lambda' = 16/R; lambda'/lambda = (16/R)/(4/R) = 4, so lambda' = 4*lambda
